name: week
title: This week in the loan set room
subtitle: Cases, sets and what is late, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Cases in the next 14 days
sections.sql: select code, surgery_on, days_to_go, hospital, surgeon, rep, sets, delivered, issue from case_readiness order by surgery_on, code

sections.title: Sets booked on two cases too close to turn around
sections.sql: select set_code, case_code, surgery_on, hospital, clashes_with from case_set_checks where clashes_with is not null order by set_code

sections.title: Sets short of their kit list
sections.sql: select set_code, sku, description, kit_qty, in_set, short from set_shortfalls order by set_code

sections.title: Sets still at a hospital
sections.sql: select set_code, case_code, hospital_name, surgery_on, days_out, return_days, rep from overdue_returns order by days_out desc

name: money
title: Money in the field
subtitle: Unbilled cases, consignment against par and stock that has not moved

sections.title: Surgery done, not invoiced
sections.sql: select code, surgery_on, days_since, hospital, rep, usage_lines, value_cents, po_number, issue from unbilled_cases order by days_since desc

sections.title: Consignment against par
sections.sql: select location, sku, description, par, on_hand, to_replenish from consignment_check order by to_replenish desc, location

sections.title: Field stock still for 180 days
sections.sql: select location, kind, sku, lot_no, qty, last_moved_on, days_still, value_cents from slow_stock order by value_cents desc

sections.title: Sets and their work
sections.sql: select set_code, kit, cases_90_days, booked_ahead, last_used_on from set_utilisation order by cases_90_days

name: traceability
title: Traceability and rules
subtitle: Expiry, recalls and the regulatory checks

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.note: Each row cites its rule. Sources in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, record, detail, due_on, days_left, source from compliance_findings order by days_left nulls last, rule

sections.title: Open recalls: where every unit is
sections.sql: select action, sku, lot_no, held_in, place, hospital, qty, case_code, surgery_on from recall_trace order by action, held_in

sections.title: Expiring within 90 days
sections.sql: select held_in, place, sku, lot_no, expires_on, days_left, qty from expiring order by expires_on
